sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against them, in C.C.No.251 of 2018 on the file of the Court of the III Additional Munsif Magistrate-cum-Judicial First Class Magistrate, Ongole.

entities.text: Additional Munsif Magistrate-cum-Judicial First Class Magistrate, Ongole
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged are under Sections 273, 188 IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard Sri Rajareddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in C.C.No.251 of 2018 on the file of the Court of the III Additional Munsif Magistrate-cum-Judicial First Class Magistrate, Ongole, for the offences under Sections 273, 188 IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
